original.subject: [FINAL] SIS Logic Validation — TS-EWS-01
original.body:
This is the final confirmation from Ridgeline Automation and Schneider Electric.

All SIS logic on TS-EWS-01 has been re-downloaded from the approved archive (v2.1.6). Checksum matches. All SIFs have passed proof test under supervision of Schneider Electric. Running logic now matches archive. No changes were made to operating logic.

The system is ready for PSSR. Do not proceed to restart until PSSR is signed and EHS confirms no residual risk.
